metadata.note: Class, subclass, ancestry, community and transformation features the engine can run as player abilities. Keys are feature names from daggerheart_player_features.json, or Group::Name when two groups share a name. Effects use the feature mapping schema, with target_type self/ally/allies for heals and clears. Approximations are spelled out in note. proficiency_dice rolls the PC's Proficiency in dice of the formula's size; scale_by multiplies an amount or dice count by level, tier, proficiency, spellcast (the PC's Spellcast trait) or a trait. roll_trait names the trait an ability rolls with: spells default to spellcast, everything else to the weapon trait. A passive with no trigger is always on (its trigger_filter says while what); one that uses tokens only while it holds some. The triggers on_damage_roll, on_damage_incoming and on_attacked pay their cost to change that one roll or hit.

Frontline Tank.note: Free at the start of the PC's turn, once 2 Armor Slots are marked and 3 Hope are held.

effects.description: Spend 3 Hope to clear 2 Armor Slots

Unstoppable.note: Switches on when the fight starts. The tokens are the die value: it starts at 1 and the feature ends when it would pass the maximum (d4, or d6 from level 5, read from the PC's level when added).

effects.description: Become Unstoppable: the die starts at 1
After a damage roll that marks a Hit Point, the die goes up by one
Add the die value to damage rolls
Physical damage is one threshold less severe
Can't be Restrained or Vulnerable

Deadly Determination.note: Free at the start of the PC's turn, once 2 Stress are marked.

effects.description: Spend 3 Hope to clear 2 Stress

Marked for Death.note: Switches on at the start of the PC's first turn and lasts the fight. The mark is assumed to follow your target for the one Stress.

effects.description: Switches on
A d4 per tier on damage to the marked target

Ambush.note: Needs Marked for Death. +1 per die is the average gain of a d6 over a d4.

effects.description: Marked for Death uses d6s

Backstab.note: Needs Marked for Death and Ambush. +1 per die is the average gain of a d8 over a d6.

effects.description: Marked for Death uses d8s
The first successful attack in a scene deals double damage

Death Strike.note: Marks Stress only up to half the track.

effects.description: Mark a Stress: the target marks an additional Hit Point

True Strike.note: Deals the weapon damage of the turned hit. Damage riders and on-hit features don't fire, and the spotlight still passes.

effects.description: Spend a Hope to make a failed attack succeed

Toxic Concoctions.note: Switches on when the fight starts and lasts the fight. 3 tokens, the average of 1d4+1. Always Leech Weed, one token per damage roll that marks a Hit Point.

effects.description: Starts with 3 tokens
Leech Weed: an extra 1d6 damage
A token is spent

Make a Scene.note: Paid before a basic attack on a target not yet Distracted. Lasts the fight.

effects.description: Spend 3 Hope: -2 to the target's Difficulty

Gifted Performer.note: Relaxing Song only, free at the start of the PC's turn once someone is wounded.

effects.description: You and all allies clear a Hit Point

Rousing Speech.note: Free at the start of the PC's turn once someone has Stress marked.

effects.description: All allies clear 2 Stress

Square Up.note: Paid before a basic attack on a target that is not Vulnerable.

effects.description: Spend 3 Hope: the target is temporarily Vulnerable

Combo Strike.note: 3d4 stands in for the Combo Die chain, which averages 7.9 with a d4. Marks Stress only up to half the track.

effects.description: Mark a Stress to add the Combo Die results

Overwhelm.note: Always the Stress. Fires on every basic-attack hit while Hope lasts.

effects.description: Spend a Hope: the target marks a Stress

Surrounded.note: Always 1 Hope. The same roll is compared to each other target's Difficulty. Reaches up to the Area Targets setting.

effects.description: The attack also hits the other targets

Eye for an Eye.note: Saved for a Severe hit, so the attacker marks 3 too.

effects.description: Mark a Stress: the attacker marks the same number of Hit Points

Pummeljoy.note: The extra Hope and the +1 Proficiency are not modelled.

effects.description: Clear an additional Stress on a critical
Clear a Stress when you take Severe damage

Elemental Incarnation.note: Always Fire, on all fight. The Stress to start Channeling is not charged, and any attacker counts, not only one in Melee range.

effects.description: An adversary who damages you takes 1d10 magic damage

Regeneration.note: Free at the start of the PC's turn, on the most wounded ally.

effects.description: Spend 3 Hope: a creature clears 1d4 Hit Points

Warden’s Protection.note: Reaches every ally rather than 1d4 of them. Free at the start of the PC's turn once someone is wounded.

effects.description: Spend 2 Hope to clear 2 Hit Points on allies

Iron Will.note: Used when the hit would still mark a Hit Point after the first Armor Slot.

effects.description: The second Armor Slot drops the severity again
Mark an additional Armor Slot

Loyal Protector.note: Uses the I Am Your Shield policy: steps in for an ally at half Hit Points or less (SRD: 2 or fewer) when healthier and the hit would not down you.

effects.description: Mark a Stress to take the damage meant for an ally

Revenge.note: Any attacker, not only one in Melee range. Marks Stress only up to half the track.

effects.description: Mark 2 Stress: the attacker marks a Hit Point

Hold Them Off.note: The same roll is compared to each other target's Difficulty. Reaches up to the Area Targets setting.

effects.description: The attack also hits two more adversaries

Ranger’s Focus.note: Assumes your target is always your Focus. The Hope to set it and the reroll are not modelled.

effects.description: Your Focus marks a Stress when you damage them

Ruthless Predator.note: The Stress on Severe damage is not modelled. Marks Stress only up to half the track.

effects.description: Mark a Stress for +1 Proficiency: one more weapon die

Apex Predator.note: Assumes your target is your Focus. The Hope is only spent on a hit.

effects.description: Spend a Hope: remove a Fear from the GM

Rogue’s Dodge.note: Paid when a +2 would turn a hit into a miss, once per such attack, rather than up front until the next hit.

effects.description: Spend 3 Hope for +2 Evasion

Sneak Attack.note: Assumes you are Cloaked or an ally is in Melee range of your target on every attack.

effects.description: A d6 per tier on the damage roll
Add your level to damage rolls while Vulnerable

Contacts Everywhere.note: Always the sniper, on the first damage roll of the fight.

effects.description: A contact adds 2d8 to the damage roll

Life Support.note: Free at the start of the PC's turn, on the most wounded ally.

effects.description: Spend 3 Hope to clear a Hit Point on an ally

Prayer Dice.note: Assumes 3 dice, all spent on reducing your own damage from hits that would be Major or worse.

effects.description: Spend a Prayer Die to reduce incoming damage by its value

Spirit Weapon.note: The same roll is compared to each other target's Difficulty. Reaches up to the Area Targets setting. Marks Stress only up to half the track.

effects.description: Mark a Stress to hit an additional adversary

Sparing Touch.note: Always the Hit Points, on the most wounded ally, free at the start of the PC's turn.

effects.description: Clear 2 Hit Points on a creature

Wings of Light.note: Assumes you are flying. Fires on every hit while Hope lasts.

effects.description: Spend a Hope for an extra 1d8 damage

Elementalist.note: Always the +3 damage, paid when the damage is rolled.

effects.description: Spend a Hope for +3 to the damage roll

Natural Evasion.note: Only paid when a d6 could turn the hit.

effects.description: Mark a Stress to add a d6 to Evasion against the attack

Transcendence.note: Switches on when the fight starts and lasts the fight. Always +1 Proficiency and +2 Evasion.

effects.description: Switches on
+1 Proficiency: one more weapon die
+2 Evasion

Manipulate Magic.note: Always doubles a damage die: an extra weapon die stands in for it. Fires on weapon attacks of any damage type. Marks Stress only up to half the track.

effects.description: Mark a Stress to double a damage die

Arcane Charge.note: Charged with 2 Hope and released on the same hit. Fires on weapon attacks of any damage type.

effects.description: +10 to the damage roll

No Mercy.note: Switches on when the fight starts, or at the start of a later turn once 3 Hope are held, and lasts the fight.

effects.description: Switches on
+1 to attack rolls
Add your level to physical damage

Rise to the Challenge.note: +4 stands in for the d20 Hope Die's higher average.

effects.description: Roll a d20 as your Hope Die at 2 or fewer Hit Points

Weapon Specialist.note: Assumes a d8 secondary weapon. Fires on every hit while Hope lasts. The Slayer Dice reroll is not modelled.

effects.description: Spend a Hope to add a secondary weapon die

Hex.note: Paid before a basic attack on a target not yet Hexed. Lasts the fight. The penalty to the target's damage is not modelled. Marks Stress only up to half the track.

effects.description: Mark a Stress: the target's Difficulty drops by your tier

Enchanted Talisman.note: The Hope is paid as each token is used rather than up front, with no limit, and only protects you.

effects.description: Spend a token to mark one Hit Point fewer

Circle of Power.note: Switches on when the fight starts and lasts the fight. Assumes Spellcast trait 3 and that you stay in the circle. A token goes with each damage roll that marks a Hit Point rather than each action roll. The +2 to thresholds and the allies' bonuses are not modelled.

effects.description: Starts with 3 tokens
+2 to attack rolls
+2 to Evasion
A token is removed
An extra 1d10 magic damage on a success with Fear

Fueled by Fear.note: Needs Face Your Fear: adds the second d10.

effects.description: Face Your Fear deals 2d10

Have No Fear.note: Needs Face Your Fear and Fueled by Fear: adds the third d10.

effects.description: Face Your Fear deals 3d10
Add your Proficiency to Evasion while you hold 2 Hope

Thrive in Chaos.note: Marks Stress only up to half the track.

effects.description: Mark a Stress: the target marks an additional Hit Point

Celestial Wings.note: Assumes you are flying. Used on a hit that would still mark a Hit Point after armor.

effects.description: Spend a Hope instead of marking an Armor Slot

Elemental Breath.note: Reaches up to the Area Targets setting.

effects.description: d8 magic damage using Proficiency

Thick Skin.note: Not used while an Armor Slot would absorb the hit anyway.

effects.description: Mark 2 Stress instead of a Hit Point from Minor damage

Increased Fortitude.note: Used on hits that would be Major or worse.

effects.description: Spend 3 Hope to halve incoming physical damage

Ignition.note: Switches on when the fight starts and lasts the fight.

effects.description: Switches on
1d6 bonus to damage rolls

Eye of the Storm.note: Switches on when the fight starts, or at the start of a later turn once 2 Hope are held, on yourself, and lasts the fight (SRD: until you take Severe damage).

effects.description: Switches on
+1 Evasion

effects.description: Mark a Stress to clear a Hit Point

Faerie::Wings.note: Assumes you are flying. Only paid when +2 would turn the hit.

effects.description: Mark a Stress for +2 Evasion against the attack

Kick.note: The knock-back is not modelled. Marks Stress only up to half the track.

effects.description: Mark a Stress for an extra 2d6 damage
The target is temporarily Vulnerable

Tusks.note: Fires on every hit while Hope lasts.

effects.description: Spend a Hope for an extra 1d6 damage
d12 physical damage using Proficiency

Gifted.note: The +1 to reaction rolls is not modelled.

+1 to damage rolls
d6 physical damage using Proficiency

Wolf Form.note: Entered the first time an attack marks a Hit Point on you, and kept all fight. The Stress when you roll with Hope is not modelled. Marks Stress only up to half the track.
